name: Angelique Retour
original_name: アンジェーリーク ルトゥール
source:
The protagonist has been chosen as one of the new queen candidates, together with her rival they take the examination.
Supported by the 9 guardians who serve the queen she works to complete the exam.
Will love bloom along the way?

A complete remake of the first Angelique game with redone art and new capturable characters.
